The 2 unpaired are the SAME instruction one slot apart on each side (UNPAIRED-T @0x0100 `lfs f3,4(r30)` / UNPAIRED-O @0x00f8 `lfs f2,4(r30)`), i.e. the displacement artifact, not structure -- so the COUNT-MISMATCH verdict must be read as REGISTER_ONLY-plus-one-slot, and the REGISTER_ONLY label the 2026-08-29 cap asserted without measurement is HONEST. MECHANISM, now named exactly. Inside the `t <= WZERO32` branch both builds re-load start[0..2] and recompute the three deltas; target issues them in x, z, y order (lfs f1,0(r30) / lfs f0,8(r30) / lfs f3,4(r30), then fsubs f1,f6,f1 / fsubs f2,f8,f0 / fsubs f31,f7,f3) which is the order `fqdist(dx,dz)` then `fqdist(len,dy)` consumes them, while ours issues y, x, z. The f6/f7/f8 triple holding point[0..2] is rotated correspondingly, so semantics agree and the whole residual is that rotation plus the one-slot lfs.
